title: Measuring Machine Learning Harms from Stereotypes Requires Understanding Who Is Harmed by Which Errors in What Ways
reasoning: The paper includes an 'Ethical considerations' section and mentions concepts like 'moral intuitions' and 'epistemic injustice' in its discussion.
